name: Project Missionary: The Reckoning of Hizzokahpolis
source:
Joseph Craig is the CEO of a logistics company who still grieves over the death of his secretary, Marie Claire. His pursuance of justice leads to an unexpected event, and even a discovery regarding the origins of the metropolis they both live in.

[From [url=https://dagitabsoft.itch.io/project-missionary]itch.io[/url]]
